title: Dashboard: Songs Progress Tracking
description: Show list of songs the user has practiced with progress percentage. MOBILE-FIRST responsive design with Tailwind.

technicalContext.schema: userSongProgress: { userId, songId, linesCompleted: number[], lastPracticed: timestamp }
technicalContext.responsive: MOBILE-FIRST: Design for 320px, scale up with Tailwind breakpoints (sm/md/lg/xl)
technicalContext.tailwind: Use Tailwind responsive utilities: grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3

acceptanceCriteria.text: Create Convex schema for userSongProgress table
Create mutation to record line completion when user clicks/practices a line
Create query to get all song progress for current user
Show 'My Songs' section with list of practiced songs
Each song shows: title, language flag, progress bar (X% complete)
Show 'Last practiced: X days ago' for each song
Click song card navigates to that song page
Empty state: 'Start practicing a song to track your progress!'
MOBILE-FIRST: Single column layout on mobile (320px+), no horizontal scroll
TAILWIND RESPONSIVE: Use sm:/md:/lg: breakpoints for grid scaling
UX: Touch targets min 44px, adequate spacing between interactive elements
UI: Consistent card design with shadow, rounded corners, hover states
